files.README.md:
# Croftwell Marquees - erection and dismantling

The crew puts a marquee up on the day of the event and takes it down after it.
Saturday work is quoted from the Saturday column; every other day follows the
weekday column. Dismantling is included in the erection charge.

turns.prompt: The Hartley wedding is at Clayhill Farm and they want the twelve by eighteen marquee. What are we charging them for putting it up?
It is a Saturday wedding. What does erecting the twelve by eighteen marquee cost on the Saturday column? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
